claim.value: The board account should distinguish established record findings, prospective causal evidence, unresolved cases and their corresponding retrieval or process follow-up.
claim.scope: Substantive evidentiary distinctions in reporting; unresolved cases and proposed follow-up are not established findings.

provenance.rationale: P022 explicitly supplies the reporting distinctions and corresponding follow-up.

signal_basis.value: Historical review checks evidence of authorized approval before placement and separately classifies supported prior approval, evidenced late or absent approval, and unresolved cases. Prospective reductions in missing attachments provide separate causal evidence, without establishing why every historical gap occurred or excluding alternative causes. Incomplete follow-up and outstanding record searches or monitoring are reported explicitly.
signal_basis.scope: The flagged historical orders and prospective observations available before the board review; causal observations do not settle individual historical cases.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans establish the distinct historical and prospective evidence streams, their inferential limits, and explicit reporting of unfinished follow-up.
The reporting distinction is warranted without establishing an additional empirical relation.

rationale: The operation produces evidence with distinct subjects and strengths, alongside unresolved questions and future actions. Keeping those categories separate in the board account faithfully represents what the evidence establishes. This licenses the identified reporting claim within its stated limits.
uncertainty: Individual historical outcomes and causal strength remain evidence-dependent; that does not undermine the warrant for distinguishing them in reporting.
